dev.title: A World's look
dev.lede: A stand-in table wearing an invented World. Each control changes one pick; the colour switch in the band is this device's own.
dev.cardText: A short line of running text, to see how the body face reads at arm's length.
dev.notes: Running text in a section stays as written: never in capitals, whatever the headings do.
dev.sheetText: A bottom sheet rises from the edge, on the card colours.
dev.handoutBody:
[06:40] The ferry did not sail.
[06:52] Lanterns lit on the far bank, three of them.
No one has claimed the crates on the east pier. Whoever holds the tally should bring it to the harbour office before the evening bell.
